title: Watching the original Knapp–Lazar Area 51 broadcast

tellings.quote: I saw the original broadcast when it happened with George Knapp and Bob Lazar of Area about Area 51, but no one knew what that meant.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, says that in 1989 he watched the original television broadcast in which a reporter, George Knapp, interviewed Bob Lazar, a man who said he had worked on alien craft near Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada. Levenda says that at the time no one knew what it meant. He tells it to mark how early that story reached the public.
